upsert.title: Hack the Audience 2026: Creator-to-CEO Hackathon
upsert.summary: Fully online month-long hackathon (5 Nov - 5 Dec 2026) for building audience-driven products. Teams of up to three; field capped at 100 teams; free entry.
upsert.eligibility: Free entry; no country, age or student limits stated on the listing. Confirm on the official page.

prize.description: US$1,600 in cash plus sponsor credits (Render, Tin Computer, .xyz) for winners.

notes: Registration deadline not stated; event runs 5 Nov - 5 Dec 2026 (UTC). Details taken from an aggregator page.

upsert.title: Entrepreneurship World Cup (EWC) 2026-27
upsert.summary: Global startup competition for idea, early and growth-stage startups plus AI tracks, with equity-free cash awards. Applications online; global finals in Riyadh.
upsert.eligibility: Open to startups at all stages; country limits not confirmed (rules page could not be read).

prize.description: Equity-free cash awards across 12 winners (up to US$200,000 Early Stage grand prize; US$160,000 Growth Stage; US$50,000 per AI track); finalists share about US$1 million.

notes: Official page showed 'Closes 31 May 2027' but cycle dates look inconsistent; confirm the deadline before applying.
